MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive-lined heat shrink feels like a useful companion to my earlier wire connectors because it lets me seal and protect those connections.",
    "The J-B Weld epoxy fits my past interest in tape and vinyl cement: it offers another way to make repairs, particularly on rigid materials."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs and threaded valve require particular cable sizes or fittings; buying wire connectors and hose clamps does not mean I need those specific parts.",
    "The grinding discs, cutting wheels, feeler gauge and thermometer serve jobs I have not shown a need to do, so their general repair usefulness is not enough for me to choose them.",
    "Both heat shrink kits relate to my wiring supplies, but I would choose the adhesive-lined option for sealing connections rather than buy two overlapping kits."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been taken as broad interest in almost any workshop or maintenance supply, while I choose supplies for particular repair needs.",
    "The recommendations stretch from clamps and small-wire connectors to specialized plumbing fittings and heavy battery terminals without enough connection to the sizes and uses I previously selected."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The purpose of a supply matters: sealing a wire connection or bonding a repair is more compelling to me here than adding equipment for unrelated tasks.",
    "Exact compatibility matters for parts such as terminals and valves; a related title alone does not establish that I can use them.",
    "My purchases span several years, so an older wiring or adhesive purchase is a clue to usefulness, not proof that the same project is still active."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in practical repair supplies but stretched it too far into specialized tools and parts without a clear current use."
}
